issues.description: The core DP recurrence is incorrect for non-root nodes. The implementation always uses the "keep one child" formula (sum(ops) - max(ops) + 1) except a special-case for a single child. Correct logic must distinguish whether the node has a parent: for non-root nodes you must delete all children before deleting the node (f(node|parent) = 1 + sum(f(child,node))), while only the root (no parent) can keep one child (f(root) = 1 + sum(f(child)) - max(f(child))). The current code computes too-small values (and fails on the provided sample).

The solution uses recursion depth up to O(N) but the execution environment sets sys.setrecursionlimit(50000). With N up to 3e5 this can cause RecursionError (stack overflow) on deep trees (e.g., a long chain). The code must be made iterative or increase recursion limit beyond N (safer: convert DFS to iterative).

No test files or unit tests were included in the submission. Automated verification of correctness (happy path and edge cases) is therefore missing; please add tests covering sample cases and edge cases (chains, star, balanced).
